question: avocado oil brands owned by which company
markdown:
Major avocado oil brands are owned by
various independent and corporate parent companies
. For instance,
Chosen Foods
is independently owned/operated as Chosen Foods LLC,
Primal Kitchen
is owned by Kraft Heinz,
La Tourangelle
is family-owned, and brands like
BetterBody Foods
and
Olivado
operate under their own respective parent health-food companies.
Major Brands and Parent Companies
Chosen Foods:
Owned by Chosen Foods LLC (headquartered in San Diego, California).
Primal Kitchen:
Owned by Kraft Heinz (acquired in 2019).
La Tourangelle:
Family-owned artisan mill based in France and California.
BetterBody Foods:
Owned by BetterBody Foods and Nutrition LLC.
Olivado:
Owned by Olivado Ltd, a pioneer in extra virgin avocado oil.
